headline: Mercado Libre Shares Fall After Q3 Results
summary: Mercado Libre reported $10.75 billion in net and financial revenue, a 45% year-over-year increase, but shares fell as operating margins tightened to 6.3%.
why: As the dominant e-commerce player in Latin America, Mercado Libre's margin performance is closely watched as an indicator of regional consumer spending and operational efficiency.

impacts.name: Mercado Libre
impacts.why: The company's operating margins contracted, leading to a share price decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors often prioritize margin health over top-line growth; a contraction in operating margins can trigger a sell-off in high-growth tech stocks.
